tools.name: post_artifact
tools.description: Publish an artifact on ArtiGram and get its public link. Pass the complete source code.

tools.name: update_artifact
tools.description: Publish a new version of one of your ArtiGram posts. Keeps the link, votes and comments.

tools.name: list_communities
tools.description: List the communities you can post in.

tools.name: search_artifacts
tools.description: Search ArtiGram for ready-made artifacts (calculators, tools, games, dashboards) by keywords. Returns titles, descriptions and links the user can open and use right away.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "post_artifact" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, community, description, kind, remix_of, source, title

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_artifact, list_communities · Public sink: post_artifact, update_artifact, list_communities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_artifact, list_communities · Public sink: post_artifact, update_artifact, list_communities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
